idea: Freight broker margin squeeze detected via trucking rate collapse

data.source: FRED series TRUCKFRT (Trucking Services Index) weekly frequency

behavior: When trucking freight rates fall sharply week-over-week, logistics companies face margin compression and often announce guidance cuts within days, triggering sector rotation.

market_impact.rationale: Industrial sector includes transport and logistics operators whose profitability is directly tied to freight rate spreads.

trade_logic.entry: If TRUCKFRT weekly value drops >3% from prior week AND 10-week moving average is still positive, short XLI
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days OR if TRUCKFRT rebounds >2% over 2 weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Weekly FRED data refreshes reliably; freight rate volatility produces 3%+ swings multiple times per quarter, especially around demand shocks.

idea: Earthquake swarm activity triggers insurance and reinsurance demand spike

data.source: USGS earthquake activity API (daily magnitude 3.0+) via earthquake_activity adapter

behavior: Clusters of earthquakes (3+ magnitude 3.0+ events in 7 days) trigger insurance broker phone calls, quote requests, and reinsurance repricing expectations, creating brief bullish waves in financial sector.

market_impact.rationale: Insurance and reinsurance companies see revenue acceleration and pricing power improvements during seismic event clusters.

trade_logic.entry: If USGS logs 3+ magnitude 3.0+ earthquakes within any rolling 7-day window in a seismically active region (CA, NV, OR, WA), buy XLF
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days OR if earthquake activity ceases for 7+ consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Earthquake swarms occur 4–6 times annually in high-activity zones; daily USGS data ensures timely detection.

idea: EV charger network saturation spillover demand signal

data.source: Open Charge Map API (weekly count of Level 3 DC fast chargers in top 10 metro areas)

behavior: When DC fast charger capacity reaches 90%+ utilization (inferred from count flattening + demand reports), EV adoption accelerates but infrastructure stress rises, triggering demand for battery tech and materials stocks.

market_impact.rationale: Battery materials (lithium, cobalt) and industrial metals see demand surge when charging infrastructure becomes constrained, signaling EV adoption acceleration.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly DC fast charger count growth falls below 0.5% YoY AND prior 4 weeks averaged >1% growth, buy XLB
trade_logic.exit: After 12 trading days OR if charger count growth rebounds above 1.5% over 2 weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: EV charger networks grow steadily but with 2–4 week plateaus per quarter as infrastructure deployment waves hit local saturation.

idea: Labor market cooling signals via job posting velocity collapse

data.source: FRED series ICSA (Initial Claims, weekly) smoothed 4-week average

behavior: When 4-week average of initial jobless claims rises >12% YoY, employers are cutting headcount faster than seasonal trends would predict, triggering rotation into defensive consumer staples.

market_impact.rationale: Consumer discretionary sector is sensitive to employment uncertainty; rising claims signal consumer spending risk.

trade_logic.entry: If ICSA 4-week MA rises >12% YoY AND above its 52-week moving average, short XLY
trade_logic.exit: After 14 trading days OR if ICSA 4-week MA falls back below 52-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Initial claims data releases weekly; threshold of 12% YoY triggers 3–5 times per year in normal labor cycles.

idea: Political insider selling surge predicts market pullback

data.source: SEC Form 4 filings aggregated by insider transaction type (sell vs. buy) via html_table adapter, weekly count

behavior: When insider sell volume exceeds buy volume by >4:1 ratio in a single week, company officers are rotating away from equity exposure, signaling private pessimism that precedes broad market weakness by 5–15 days.

market_impact.rationale: Technology insiders are most active traders; their selling surge often signals sector-wide confidence loss.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly Form 4 insider sell count to buy count ratio exceeds 4:1, short XLK
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days OR if sell-to-buy ratio drops below 2:1

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Insider filing flow is constant; 4:1 ratios appear 4–8 times per quarter, especially around earnings seasons.

idea: Utility sector rate hike anxiety from weather-driven demand spike

data.source: Open-Meteo daily temperature data (US national area-weighted) + EIA electricity demand via eia_electricity adapter

behavior: When daily average temperature deviation from seasonal norm exceeds +8°F AND EIA daily electricity demand reaches 90%+ of recent capacity, utility companies see margin pressure from capped rates, triggering brief defensive demand.

market_impact.rationale: Utilities are defensive when rate hike pressure is evident; high demand periods force regulators and investors to acknowledge margin stress, driving safe-haven rotation into utilities.

trade_logic.entry: If temperature deviation >+8°F AND EIA demand >90% capacity AND XLU closes above 20-day SMA, buy XLU
trade_logic.exit: After 6 trading days OR if temperature normalizes AND demand falls below 80% capacity

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Daily weather and EIA data update constantly; extreme temperatures and demand spikes occur 8–12 times per year in US regions.

idea: Travel sentiment surge from airline load factor rebound signals discretionary recovery

data.source: BTS airline load factor (weekly average) via bts_airline_load_factor adapter

behavior: When airline load factors jump >2 percentage points week-over-week (e.g., 82% to 84.5%), it signals unexpected travel demand surge, triggering hospitality and leisure spending expectations.

market_impact.rationale: Airlines are leading indicator for leisure travel; rising load factors predict hotel, restaurant, and entertainment spending booms.

trade_logic.entry: If BTS load factor jumps >2 percentage points WoW AND closes above 52-week MA, buy XLY
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days OR if load factor drops >1.5 percentage points in following week

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Weekly BTS data shows 2+ percentage point swings 4–6 times per year, especially around holidays and seasonal travel peaks.

idea: Consumer debt stress spike from credit card delinquency news surge

data.source: RSS news feed count for terms 'credit card delinquency' + 'loan default' + 'debt burden' via rss_count adapter, daily

behavior: When daily RSS news mentions of consumer debt stress terms spike >120% above 30-day average, it signals mainstream media focus on household fragility, predicting flight to safety and defensive sector outperformance.

market_impact.rationale: Consumer discretionary spending faces headwinds when media highlights rising debt stress; rotation into staples and health care follows within days.

trade_logic.entry: If daily RSS count for debt stress terms exceeds 30-day MA by >120%, short XLY immediately
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days OR if RSS count reverts to <110% of 30-day MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Consumer financial stress news clusters occur 6–10 times per year; daily RSS feeds capture spikes in real time.

idea: Renewable energy investment thesis rebound from policy sentiment surge

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for terms 'renewable energy jobs' + 'solar tax credit' + 'wind energy news', via google_trends adapter

behavior: When combined Google Trends volume for renewable energy policy/jobs terms spikes >40% above 52-week baseline, institutional investors anticipate policy tailwinds, triggering brief bullish rotation into clean energy and utilities.

market_impact.rationale: Utilities and renewable energy companies benefit from policy momentum signaled by rising public interest in clean energy topics.

trade_logic.entry: If Google Trends combined volume for renewable terms exceeds 52-week MA by >40%, buy XLU
trade_logic.exit: After 9 trading days OR if Google Trends volume falls below 52-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Google Trends for renewable energy topics spike 5–7 times per year around policy announcements, earnings, and seasonal events.

idea: Financial sector repricing from bank deposit outflow alerts

data.source: FRED series WIMFSL (Weekly Insured Moneysaver Rate) + RSS count for 'bank run' + 'deposit flight' terms, weekly frequency

behavior: When WIMFSL (money market fund rates) spike >50 bps week-over-week AND RSS mentions of deposit flight spike >150% above baseline, it signals depositor unease, triggering brief weakness in regional bank stocks and financials rotation.

market_impact.rationale: Banks face NIM compression and credit risk when deposit flight accelerates; financial sector reprices downward before recovery.

trade_logic.entry: If WIMFSL spikes >50 bps WoW AND RSS deposit flight mentions exceed 150% of 4-week MA, short XLF
trade_logic.exit: After 11 trading days OR if WIMFSL normalizes back toward prior week level

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Money market rates and financial sector anxiety events occur 3–5 times per year; weekly data ensures timely signal detection.
